1.title: Every AI Company Is Accidentally Building a Bank — Dor Sasson, Stigg
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: AI companies need banking infrastructure (synchronous entitlement checks, asynchronous settlement, credit pools) to avoid pricing emergencies—OpenAI's architecture as the model.

2.title: Grep or Embeddings? Agentic Search Over Company Documents — George He, LlamaIndex
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: Agent-driven hybrid search strategy for company documents—grep + embeddings + metadata filtering + visual parsing—with a production demo on 135 Alphabet filings.

3.title: The 6 Pillars of an Agentic Harness for Production — Varun Krovvidi, Resolve AI
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: Six concrete pillars for production agents — model orchestration, context engineering, causal reasoning, governed actions, learning systems, evals — with a demo showing root-cause diagnosis that rules out coincidental outages.

1.title: Is Speculative Decoding Worth It? Profiling vLLM on NVIDIA Blackwell — Akamai
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Speculative decoding demo on Blackwell showing 1.6x speedup for structured output but low acceptance on creative writing, with a checklist for when it's worth the memory cost of a second model.

1.title: From 36% to 100%: How Self-Improving Agents Write Their Own Skills — Rafal Wilinski, Runlayer
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Self-improving agents that distill their own skills from execution traces, taking a task from 36% to 100% success and creating an organizational knowledge flywheel.

2.title: Redesigning How Software Gets Built With AI Agents — Sonar & McKinsey Panel
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: Teams scaling AI agents change three things—process, tooling, and people/roles—and trust in code automation grows incrementally from review → blocking → autofix → auto-approve/merge.

3.title: Why AI Agents Should Have Their Own Sandbox — Philipp Schmid, Google DeepMind
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: Google's Gemini Interactions API replaces user/model turns with a timeline of steps, handles server-side state and background jobs, and gives each agent its own managed cloud sandbox with persistent environments and shared skills.
